# Tendriller

Authenticated pages connected to agents through dependable mechanisms. The page owns its layout, interaction and application data. Cookbook content guides choices; it installs nothing.

## Platform interfaces

- [Agent guide](https://tendriller.dev/agent.md): creation, explicit delivery, plain-file publication and page-owned interaction.
- [Service descriptor](https://tendriller.dev/api/service): installed capabilities, contract, release and effective limits.
- [Contract schema](https://tendriller.dev/contract/v3.json): executable wire schema.
- [Protocol](https://tendriller.dev/docs/PROTOCOL.md): identity, authorization, command generations and atomicity.
- [MCP](https://tendriller.dev/docs/MCP.md): authenticated tools for immutable uploads, shared files and publications.
- [Browser API](https://tendriller.dev/docs/BROWSER_API.md): headless transport, state, conversation, streams, captures and device APIs.
- [Application backends](https://tendriller.dev/docs/APPLICATION_BACKENDS.md): durable programs, view changes, authenticated event origins, independent lifecycle/outcomes, retries, replay and distinct authority roles.
- [Live signals](https://tendriller.dev/docs/APPLICATION_SIGNALS.md): independent ephemeral send/subscribe, FIFO versus latest, expiration and standalone composition.
- [Streams](https://tendriller.dev/docs/STREAMS.md): ordered observations, replay, retention and resource policy.
- [Captures](https://tendriller.dev/docs/CAPTURES.md): durable media, review and event acceptance.
- [Voice](https://tendriller.dev/docs/HANDS_FREE.md): explicit optional input/output, local controls and browser limits.
- [Architecture](https://tendriller.dev/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): ownership, public artifacts and publication coherence.

## Optional operational software

- [Core releases](https://github.com/werg/tendriller/releases): SDK, runtime, engine and separate tools archives with immutable hashes.
- [CLI](https://tendriller.dev/docs/tools/CLI.md): publish authored files without scaffolding or dependency injection.
- [Preview](https://tendriller.dev/docs/tools/PREVIEW.md): exact-file local preview and explicit fixture limits.
- [Host delivery](https://tendriller.dev/docs/tools/AGENT_HOSTS.md): connect the intended agent conversation and acknowledge work after effects.
- [Collectors](https://tendriller.dev/docs/tools/COLLECTOR.md): bounded telemetry sources, spooling and loss reporting.

## Adaptable knowledge

- [Cookbook collection](https://github.com/werg/tendriller-contrib): outcome guides, algorithms, alternatives and failure cases.
- [Cookbook agent index](https://github.com/werg/tendriller-contrib/blob/main/agent.md): discover relevant guidance before implementing a task-specific page.

Inspect the task and existing files. Choose an approach, explain consequential tradeoffs, author the interface, and exercise the relevant failure cases. Preserve platform guarantees while adapting example markup, state paths and parameters. Explicitly selected trusted server capabilities require operator review and deployment; reading a guide or publishing a page cannot enable them.
